title: Shared HRTF field with Mirror listener codes versus retrieval
hypothesis: A shared data-derived HRTF field plus a small listener-specific sparse code can reconstruct held-out listeners from 3 or 5 measured directions with quality near retrieval, while reducing total serialized bytes once the shared field is amortized across enough listeners; ordinary sparse PCA coefficients may match Mirror exactly.
physical_object: shared mean HRTF map and rank-8 cross-listener residual basis fit on 30 measured SONICOM listeners
mirror_coordinate: four-term sparse listener code over shared basis atoms, selected from sparse direction measurements

selection.method: secrets.randbelow over sorted eligible P0/UNTESTED IDs after live branch exclusions

dataset.name: SONICOM HRTF dataset, 48 kHz FreeFieldCompMinPhase SOFA
dataset.dataset_license: MIT per SONICOM and RANF documentation

development.purpose: select only ridge regularization from {0, 1e-4, 1e-2, 1}; Mirror sparse support is fixed at 4 of rank 8; no model-rank or split changes
development.selection_summary: ridge 0 minimized development mean LSD among {0,1e-4,1e-2,1}; chosen without opening fresh subjects.

quality.evaluation_directions: all directions excluding the given 3/5 calibration indices

storage.accounting: Report shared field bytes once plus all personalized code bytes, per-listener amortized bytes for 1/6/12/24/48 targets, and independent full-map bytes. Retrieval baseline includes the serialized training-listener HRTF database it requires and its selected listener index.
paid_objects: listener coefficient values and sparse indices
listener identifier and support-direction index metadata

compute.report_gpu: unavailable; no neural field training claim

success_gate: 3/3 fresh quality gate for each sparsity: Mirror LSD <= retrieval LSD + 1.0 dB, ILD MAE <= retrieval + 1.0 dB and ITD MAE <= retrieval + 100 us; amortized payload at 24 held-out listener maps <=0.75x independent full-map bytes.
mirror_specific_gate: Mirror top-4 code must beat ordinary top-4 sparse PCA code by >=10% actual personalized bytes or a predeclared quality gain at matched bytes/compute.
failure_gate: Mirror misses the quality/storage gate or ordinary sparse PCA code matches it within 10% bytes and metric tolerances.
boundaries: The run is a real measured-HRTF field screen, not a reproduction of the RANF neural model.
No PyTorch/GPU training; RANF itself is not evaluated. Its learning-free HRTF selection/retrieval control is approximated using only train-subject maps and the allowed calibration directions.
Only acoustic signal metrics are measured; no listener study or spatial-perception claim.
Subject identities and split are fixed before data access; no demographic attributes are used.
Training corpus and shared basis bytes are paid and amortized; no parameter-count-only storage claims.
implementation_amendments: Before development, NumPy>=2 compatibility shim added for sofar 1.1.3.
Before development, spatialaudiometrics 0.0.8 ITD list-division bug was bypassed by reproducing the documented MAXIACC estimator with NumPy output.

After first fresh evaluation, serializer audit found omitted per-listener identity and nearest-control support indices. These deterministic metadata fields were added; no quality method, split, support, rank, or ridge setting changed. The fixed dev/fresh outputs were regenerated for corrected byte accounting.
